# Arch-loop follow-up row I -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `arch_test.mjs ... I`. Printed on the **same bed** as `20261029_arch-loop-8-rows-PLA.gcode` -- don't clear the sheet. Row I sits at Y=137, above row H (Y 123-127).

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=40, printed first (the next free step in the calibration sequence; y=75 from the 8-row print is already on this bed). `verifyLayout` against everything already on the bed (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

**Change from row B** (everything else identical: H 3, S 3, 6 loops, same anchors, fan on):

| | row B | row I |
|---|---|---|
| arch strand e/d (rise, bridge, descent) | 0.05 | 0.075 (+50%) |
| rise / bridge / descent F (mm/min) | 300 / 300 / 400 | 150 / 150 / 200 |
| filament per loop's bridge (mm) | 0.150 | 0.225 |
| time on the bridge (s) | 0.6 | 1.2 |
| melt flow while bridging (mm3/s) | 0.60 | 0.45 |

More plastic per mm of strand (a thicker, stiffer strand) delivered more slowly, so the fan has longer to set it before the nozzle moves on. Note the melt flow per second actually goes DOWN, because the speed drops more than the extrusion rises.

| row | Y | shape | dir | H (mm) | S (mm) | loops | pitch gap | rise / bridge / down F | top dwell | fan | ~mm3/s at bridge | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I | 137 | staple | x | 3.0 | 3.0 | 6 | 3.0 | 150 / 150 / 200 | - | on | 0.45 | row B with the arch strand at +50% extrusion (e/d 0.05 -> 0.075) and every arch move at half speed -- a thicker, slower strand so the bridge hangs |

**What to look for**: compare directly with row B (Y=39). Does the bridge stay level instead of sagging? Is the strand visibly thicker? Any blobs at the top corners from the slower moves?

Totals: 1392 G-code lines, 11.5 mm commanded filament.
